name: INSURE-ALL-a-side-effect-paid
old: return rows.reduce((g, e) => g + Math.max(0, enchantmentRowCost(e) ?? 0), 0) * GOLD_PER_ENCHANTMENT_POINT;

name: INSURE-ALL-the-rows-own-cost-read
old: return rows.reduce((g, e) => g + Math.max(0, enchantmentRowCost(e) ?? 0), 0) * GOLD_PER_ENCHANTMENT_POINT;
new: return rows.reduce((g, e) => g + Math.max(0, e.enchantCost ?? 0), 0) * GOLD_PER_ENCHANTMENT_POINT;

name: INSURE-ALL-the-gold-per-point-dropped
old: return rows.reduce((g, e) => g + Math.max(0, enchantmentRowCost(e) ?? 0), 0) * GOLD_PER_ENCHANTMENT_POINT;
